name: Zacchaeus
title: The Tax Collector in the Tree
summary: Zacchaeus was a chief tax collector in Jericho, wealthy but despised by the people for collaborating with the Romans. He was short in stature and climbed up into a sycamore-fig tree to see Jesus. Jesus invited himself to his home, which led to Zacchaeus's radical repentance and generosity.

keyEvents.title: In the Sycamore-Fig Tree
keyEvents.description: Zacchaeus climbed up in a tree to see Jesus because he was short in stature.

keyEvents.title: Jesus Invites Himself
keyEvents.description: Jesus looked up and said that he must stay at Zacchaeus's house today.

keyEvents.title: The Repentance
keyEvents.description: Zacchaeus promised to give half to the poor and repay fourfold anyone he had cheated.
